arch.description: Client architecture for LTSP images (e.g., i386, amd64, armhf).

client_env.description: Default environment variables passed to all LTSP clients at boot.

client_overrides.description: Per-client configuration overrides (by MAC or hostname). Each entry defines a client's hostname and optional settings.

client_ssh_enabled.description: Allow SSH access from clients (use with caution in production).

dhcp_broadcast.description: Broadcast address for the client network.

dhcp_dns.description: List of DNS servers to advertise to clients (space-separated or comma-separated in config).

dhcp_enabled.description: Enable the built-in LTSP DHCP server. If disabled, configure an external DHCP server manually.

dhcp_extra_options.description: Additional custom DHCP options as key-value pairs (e.g., {"66": "next-server", "67": "pxelinux.0"}).

dhcp_filename.description: Initial boot file (PXE filename) served to clients.

dhcp_gateway.description: Default gateway IP address advertised to clients.

dhcp_next_server.description: TFTP server IP (usually the LTSP server itself).

dhcp_range_end.description: Last IP address in the DHCP lease range.

dhcp_range_start.description: First IP address in the DHCP lease range (e.g., for thin clients).

https_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS for the LTSP web management interface (requires SSL cert).

https_port.description: Port for the HTTPS management interface.

log_file.description: Path to LTSP server log file (leave empty to log only to syslog).

ltsp_image_root.description: Path to the LTSP chroot image directory where client root filesystems are stored.

nfs_export_enabled.description: Enable NFS export of the LTSP image root (required for diskless clients).

nfs_export_options.description: NFS export options for the LTSP image.

nfs_export_path.description: Path exported over NFS (typically matches LTSP_IMAGE_ROOT).

nfs_no_root_squash.description: Allow NFS root access to clients (set to false for stricter security).

tftp_enabled.description: Enable TFTP service (required for PXE boot).

tftp_root.description: TFTP server root directory containing bootloaders and config files.
